A scalar query measures q coordinates and must distinguish the truth from an alternative. The corpus states its per-sample information against an alternative parameterised by (d, x): d coordinates displaced by μ, the remaining q − d displaced by x. Two objections stand against using that statement.

Second, the design weights that reproduce the corpus's coefficients were FITTED — a consistent non-negative solution in 24 of 24 parameter cells is evidence that the coefficients come from the model, but it is not a derivation. This work removes both objections.
What the literature leaves open
The literature therefore leaves a specific opening.

No existing treatment simultaneously: (i) proves a constructive alternative family extremal and exactly tight; (ii) derives the design weights from the budget rather than fitting them; (iii) retains the score surplus in the exchange bound so that a margin appears explicitly; and (iv) exhibits a sharp threshold at which Top-C selection stops being optimal.

III.  Results

THE DERIVED WEIGHTS MATCH ALL 24 CELLS EXACTLY. Across q ∈ {8, 16}, μ ∈ {1/4, 2/5}, c ∈ {3/2, 2} and η ∈ {1/3, 13/20, 4/5}, the fitted weights agree with the derived formula in every cell, and the budget identity holds exactly in each. The weights vary with (η, c) and are constant across (q, μ), exactly as the derivation predicts.
Eight of eight cells certify the strict separation across the whole cell, all of them by the left-endpoint test, with exact rational gaps. THE PAIR QUERY IS NECESSARY WHEREVER IT IS USED.

Before the derivation it was the evidence — 24 consistent cells, suggestive but not conclusive, licensing no prediction at a 25th cell. After it, the table is a check on the arithmetic: the theorem says the agreement must hold at every (q,μ,c,η), so a disagreeing cell would now be an implementation bug rather than a puzzle.

That every certificate came from the same endpoint is itself informative: the modulus decays across the cell, so the binding case is the left edge, and a procedure testing the midpoint would have been testing the easy case.
The three cells without a certificate are exactly those where the pair weight is zero.
IV.  Discussion

THE NECESSITY CONSTRUCTION DOES NOT COLLAPSE OFF THE CORNER — IT DEGRADES. Sufficiency is proved for every product reference, necessity only at the corner, and nothing in the development says what happens between.

The first sweep moved the reference symmetrically, which is the direction the construction is symmetric in. Widened to asymmetric references drawn independently per coordinate, the Top-C set is lost MORE often, 49.6% against 41.2%, and the four structured directions less often, 18.0%.

At μ = 2 the Top-C set is retained at every one of 903 references — symmetric, structured and asymmetric — and the regret is non-positive at every t > 0. That cannot confirm a theorem proved for all references, but it exercises it where the necessity construction lives.
Limitations — what is not established

The reduction is for the scalar query only. The pair query has a blind direction, so the coordinate-wise argument of Theorem cannot start: there are non-zero shifts it cannot see, and no positive lower bound holds uniformly over its class. Lower bounds only. An upper bound quantified over the slice still says nothing about the class.

An alternative set defined by a norm bound or a subspace is outside every statement here, and nothing in the formal development can detect a mismatch, because it is a modelling question. What the development does is make the hypothesis explicit in the statement. The information formulas are premises.
The necessity half of the threshold is proved only at the corner. Theorem is a statement about corner-reference instances and no claim is proved beyond them.
Theorem identifies where a transition can occur and does not establish that the condition is met anywhere in the parameter range of interest.
V.  Conclusions

The two-parameter alternative family is not a restriction, the design is not fitted, and the margin at which Top-C selection stops being optimal is sharp at 2δ. Sufficiency holds under every product reference; necessity is proved at the corner, and measured to survive a neighbourhood of it whose size grows with the margin.

The honest summary is narrower than this work first claimed and broader than the theorem states: the construction degrades rather than collapses, and at the threshold margin no reference tested defeats it.
How the numbers were produced

EVERY DEFINITION IS TRANSCRIBED, NOT RE-DERIVED. The gate, the coefficient map, the steered world and the compression loss come from the formal sources rather than being rebuilt for the experiment — an earlier version invented its own construction and produced a confident, wrong answer.
It does, in every configuration. EXACT RATIONALS THROUGHOUT, so a reported flip is a flip and not a rounding artefact, and the breakdown point is located to 1/64 rather than estimated.
